name: dev-services-dashboard
description: A lightweight development UI dashboard for managing and monitoring multiple services during local development

scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun audit && bun run build
scripts.build: bun run update-readme && bun run update-changelog && bun run build-frontend && bun run create-frontend-bundle && tsup
scripts.build-frontend: cd src/frontend-react && bun install && bun run build
scripts.dev-frontend: cd src/frontend-react && bun install && bun run dev
scripts.demo: bun run build-frontend && bun run create-frontend-bundle && bun run scripts/demo.ts
scripts.demo-minimal-tabs: bun run build-frontend && bun run create-frontend-bundle && bun run scripts/demo-minimal-tabs.ts
scripts.update-readme: markdown-toc-gen update README.md && bun run scripts/update-readme-version.ts

author: Kevin Whitman (https://github.com/keverw)
